added: With Custom Figures on, the starting, meanwhile and modifier default figures in Settings › Defaults offer your own new figures for the default dance form, and Move defaults links to each of your figures, where its own defaults are set.

Deleting one of your new figures leaves your default figures with its current wording as plain text, and its confirmation says how many dances in the Trash use it, which keep the line each last stored, and whether your default figures use it.
`freezeUserFigureUsesIn` makes a list's uses of a figure of your own plain text, as a delete freezes a dance, and `DanceRepository.countTrashedDancesUsingUserFigure` counts the Trash's uses (#1023).
